raw.excerpt: For decades, DTN has been the silent force behind some of the world’s most critical industries—helping businesses navigate complexity, uncertainty, and risk with smarter, faster decisions.
raw.description:
For decades, DTN has been the silent force behind some of the world’s most critical industries—helping businesses navigate complexity, uncertainty, and risk with smarter, faster decisions. From agriculture to energy to weather intelligence, our proprietary Operational Decisioning Platform transforms raw data into decision-grade insights—enabling companies to optimize supply chains, ensure market stability, and safeguard infrastructure against disruption. We don’t follow trends—we set the standard for precision, trust, and operational impact.

DTN is at an exciting inflection point. Building off a foundation of financial strength, profitability, and industry trust, we’re accelerating growth and expanding our global footprint. Our purpose-built solutions—powered by AI and honed by decades of vertical expertise—are helping some of the world’s most significant enterprises thrive amid operational constraints and uncover new opportunities in a fast-changing world.

Job Description:

DTN is seeking a highly experienced Senior Software Engineer – Workday Finance to join our Finance engineering organization and build scalable, reliable, and secure software solutions supporting critical financial business processes.

In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain high-quality software for enterprise Finance applications and services. You will work closely with Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, QA, and Finance domain experts to translate complex business requirements into robust technical solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with experience building distributed, cloud-based enterprise applications and an understanding of financial systems and business processes.

What You Will Be Responsible For

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain highly scalable software services supporting Workday Finance capabilities
  • Own complex technical problems from requirements and architecture through implementation, production deployment, and ongoing support
  • Design and implement reliable APIs, backend services, data models, and distributed systems
  • Develop solutions supporting financial transactions, accounting, billing, revenue, reporting, and related Finance workflows
  • Ensure financial data is accurate, consistent, secure, traceable, and auditable
  • Design systems capable of handling high transaction volumes while meeting performance, availability, and reliability requirements
  • Build resilient services with appropriate handling of retries, failures, duplicate transactions, and data reconciliation
  • Participate in architecture and design reviews and influence technical direction
  • Partner with Product Management and Finance subject-matter experts to translate business requirements into effective technical designs
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and continuously improve system reliability, performance, and observability
  • Develop automated unit, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Contribute to CI/CD, DevOps, monitoring, logging, and operational excellence
  • Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, improve engineering processes, and reduce technical debt
  • Mentor other engineers and provide technical leadership within the team
  • Champion engineering best practices through code reviews and continuous improvement initiatives

What You Will Bring to the Position

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience with demonstrated ownership of complex systems
  • Strong programming experience in one or more modern languages such as Java, Python, C++, Go, or similar
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles
  • Experience designing and developing distributed systems and scalable backend services
  • Strong experience with RESTful APIs, service-oriented or microservice architectures, and asynchronous/event-driven systems
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience
  • Experience with cloud technologies and modern software development practices
  • Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, logging, and production support
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex technical problems and develop practical, scalable solutions
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Experience developing ERP, Finance, accounting, billing, revenue, or financial management software
  • Understanding of financial concepts including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, billing, revenue recognition, accounting periods, and financial reporting
  • Experience with high-volume transaction-processing systems
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and distributed messaging systems
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or comparable container technologies
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, or other cloud platforms
  • Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Familiarity with financial data reconciliation, auditability, and data-integrity requirements
  • Experience working within an enterprise SaaS environment
  • Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring experience

What You Can Expect from DTN

  • Competitive Salary
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Flexible working hours
  • Remote work model (position dependent)
  • Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance Plans
  • 6% 401K matching
  • Unlimited access to 13k+ courses via learning platform to support employee career advancement
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Compensation

The targeted hiring base pay range for this position is between $109,500 and $145,500. DTN is a pay for performance organization, which means there is the opportunity to advance your compensation with performance over time. The actual base pay offered for this position will be dependent upon many factors, including but not limited to: prior work experience, training/education, transferable skills, business needs, internal equity and applicable laws. The targeted hiring base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for market competitive variable pay and benefits.

About DTN:

DTN is a global data and technology company helping operational leaders in energy, agriculture, and weather-driven industries make faster, smarter decisions. Our Operational Decisioning Platform turns complex data into decision-grade insights—empowering customers to expand their margins, accelerate growth, and outpace risk. With more than 1,200 employees globally, DTN serves the companies that feed, fuel, and protect the world.

At DTN, we value clarity,trust, and action. We’re a team of problem-solvers, outcome-drivers, and industry nerds who believe that precision matters – and that mission is at the core of what we do.

  • Trust Built: We earn it. We keep it. We protect it. Our neutrality, precision, and integrity are non-negotiable.

  • Confidence-Driven: We help customers move with clarity and conviction. We bring the data and operational knowledge leaders need to act.

  • Built for Industry: We speak operations because we come from operations. Our expertise is forged in fuel terminals, fields, flight paths, and forecasts.

  • Future-Forward: We see what’s coming- and we’re ready. We help customers lead through change with smarter decisioning.

Recruitment Fraud Notice:

DTN is aware of incidents where external parties have impersonated our organization, issuing fraudulent communications and/or job offers. Please be advised that all legitimate communication from DTN will come from an official @dtn.com email address. Any offers are extended directly by our Talent Acquisition team following a formal interview process.


If you receive a suspicious message or offer claiming to be from DTN, please do not engage. Contact our Talent Acquisition team at to verify the legitimacy of any communication. Report any fraudulent messaging as phishing or spam.

DTN is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage applicants of all backgrounds, including minorities, women, veterans, and individuals with disabilities.

raw.description:
About Simply.TV

At Simply.TV, we're redefining how the world experiences TV metadata. As a leading provider of advanced, AI-driven metadata solutions, we empower broadcasters, streaming platforms, and telecom operators to deliver smarter, more engaging content discovery experiences. From next-gen EPG (Electronic Program Guide) data to rich content enrichment, we enable our partners to stay ahead in a rapidly evolving media landscape.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, but supported by 400+ employees worldwide, our data fuels user interfaces that are used by millions of viewers every day — and we’re just getting started. Whether you're passionate about media technology, data engineering, or product innovation, Simply.TV is the place to shape the future of TV — and have fun doing it.

Join us, and let’s make content discovery simple, powerful, and inspiring!

The Role

For candidates based in Mexico!

As a Station Coordinator, you will be part of our Ingest team and play an important role in managing information received from broadcasters and content owners, primarily across the US market. You will monitor incoming requests, make sure information is correctly understood and processed, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate with the right internal teams to keep our workflows running smoothly.

The role combines data operations, technical problem-solving, and external communication. You will work closely with our ingest and technical teams, as well as broadcasters and content owners, while learning and working with Simply.TV's internal systems and workflows.

This is a great opportunity for someone who is highly organized, has excellent English and written communication skills, is interested in technology, and enjoys solving problems and learning new systems.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor and process a high volume of incoming emails from US broadcasters and content owners, ensuring information is correctly understood and handled.
  • Review and validate channel-related information, including channel launches, changes, rebranding, and channels ceasing operations.
  • Process incoming information through internal systems and established workflows, ensuring data is accurately recorded and routed to the appropriate teams.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot data or workflow issues independently, escalating to the relevant technical teams when required.
  • Track incoming requests, changes, and follow-ups to maintain clear visibility across workflows and ensure nothing is missed.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with internal teams and external partners, providing structured questions, updates, and findings.
  • Use internal ticketing and workflow systems to assign and coordinate tasks with the appropriate teams.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and historical records of changes and actions taken.
  • Collaborate with ingest, technical, editorial, schedule, and other relevant teams to ensure accurate and timely processing of broadcaster information.
  • Build and maintain effective communication with external partners to support data accuracy, consistency, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

You'll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally.
  • Have a strong interest in technology and enthusiasm for learning new systems, tools, and workflows.
  • Can write structured, formal emails and communicate information clearly and concisely.
  • Are highly organized, diligent, and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple requests and follow-ups.
  • Can investigate problems independently, identify potential causes, and determine the appropriate next steps.
  • Are comfortable following established workflows and pipelines while keeping accurate documentation.
  • Can structure and synthesize information and communicate findings effectively to colleagues and managers.
  • Are comfortable working with a high volume of incoming information while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Are able to work independently while knowing when to involve or escalate to the appropriate team.

Preferred

  • Previous experience in data operations, technical support, coordination, content operations, or a similar role.
  • Experience communicating with external partners, customers, vendors, or other stakeholders.
  • Basic Excel skills.
  • Familiarity with XML, JSON, CSV, or other structured data formats.
  • Experience working with ticketing systems, data management tools, or internal business systems.
  • Previous experience in media, TV, streaming, broadcasting, or OTT.
  • Knowledge of the US, Canadian, or Mexican TV and streaming landscape.
  • Spanish or French language skills.
  • Experience working in a B2B environment is a plus.

What we offer

  • The opportunity to work in a growing international company at the intersection of technology, data, and media.
  • Exposure to broadcasters and content owners across the North American market.
  • The opportunity to develop technical, data operations, and external communication skills.
  • A role where you can learn proprietary systems and workflows and gradually take ownership of your work.
  • Potential opportunities to grow within Ingest, Technical Account Management, Sales Support, or other areas of the business as opportunities arise.

Practicalities

  • Reports to: Head of Technical Account Management
  • Employment Type: Freelancer
  • Location: Canada
  • Type of Collaboration: Freelancer setup ( Fulltime-40hrs/week)

Benefits

Collaboration based on a freelancer set-up is up to 3500USD per month on a full-time allocation basis (40 hours per week).

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Pre-Service Center (PSC) Verification Specialist role belongs to the Revenue Cycle Patient Access team and is responsible for coordinating all financial clearance activities by navigating all pre-registration (to include acquiring or validating patient demographic, insurance, and other required elements along with insurance verification activities), obtaining referral authorization or precertification number(s), and pre-service cash collections. The role ensures timely access to care while maximizing BMC hospital reimbursement. This role requires adherence to quality assurance guidelines as well as established productivity standards to support the work unit’s performance expectations. This position reports to the Pre-Service Center Supervisor and requires interaction and collaboration with important stakeholders in the financial clearance process, including but not limited to insurance company representatives, patients, physicians, Boston Medical Center (BMC) practice staff, case management, and Patient Financial Counseling. This is a Remote Position.

Position: Pre Service Center (PSC) Specialist

Department: Ambulatory

Schedule: Full Time

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES:

  • Monitors accounts routed to registration, referral, and prior authorization work queues and clears work queues by obtaining all necessary patient and/or payer-specific financial clearance elements in accordance with established management guidelines.

  • Maintains knowledge of and complies with insurance companies’ requirements for obtaining prior authorizations/referrals, and completes other activities to facilitate all aspects of financial clearance.

  • Acts as a subject matter expert in navigating both the BMC and payer policies to get the appropriate approvals (authorizations, pre-certs, referrals, for example) for the scheduled care to proceed. The PSC Verification Specialist is an important part of the larger patient care team and helps clinicians understand what payer requirements are necessary for the widest possible patient access to services.

  • Supports BMC staff at all levels for hands-on help in understanding and navigating financial clearance issues.

  • Uses appropriate strategies to underscore the most efficient process for obtaining insurance verification, authorizations, and referrals, including online databases, electronic correspondence, faxes, and phone calls.

  • Obtains and clearly documents all referral/prior authorizations for scheduled services before admission within the Epic environment.

  • Works collaboratively with primary care practices, specialty practices, referring physicians, primary care physicians, insurance carriers, patients and any other parties to ensure that required managed care referrals and prior authorizations for specified specialty visits and other services are obtained and appropriately recorded in the relevant practice management systems for patient appointments/visits before scheduled patient visits or retro-actively if not in place at the time of the appointment/visit. Ensure that approval numbers are appropriately linked to the relevant patient appointment/visit.

  • When it is determined that a valid referral does not exist, utilize computer-based tools or contact the appropriate party to obtain/generate referral/authorization and related information. Record the referral/authorization in the practice management system.

  • Contact internal and external primary care physicians to obtain referral/authorization numbers.

  • Perform follow-up activities indicated by relevant management reports and WQs.

  • Collaborate with patients, providers, and departments to obtain all necessary information and payer permissions before patients’ scheduled services.

  • Communicates with patients, providers, and other departments such as Utilization Review to resolve any issues or problems with obtaining required referral/prior authorizations.

  • Works collaboratively with the practices to resolve registration, insurance verification, referral, or authorization issues to the extent that these unresolved issues impact the ability to obtain a referral/authorization.

  • Escalate accounts that have been denied or will not be financially cleared as outlined by department policy

  • Interview patients, families, or referring physicians via telephone in advance of the patient’s appointment/visit whenever possible, to obtain all necessary information, including but not limited to, financial and demographic information required for reimbursement and compliance for services rendered.

  • Accept registration updates from various intake points, including, but not limited to, paper forms, internet registration forms, practice telephones, and direct calls from patients and facilities.

  • Ensure that all updated demographic and insurance information is accurately recorded in the appropriate registration systems for primary, secondary, and tertiary insurances.

  • Review all registration and insurance information in systems and reconcile with information available from insurance carriers. For any insurance updates, utilize any available resources to validate the updated insurance information, insurance plan eligibility, primary care physician, subscriber information, employer information, and appointment/visit information. Contact patients as necessary if clarifications or other follow-up are required, and at all times maintain sensitivity and a clear, customer-friendly approach.

  • For any patient who is new to Boston Medical Center, create a new registration record, accurately obtaining all required data elements, including generating a medical record number, and complete a full registration for the patient.

  • For self-pay patients or patients with unresolved insurance, and for financial counseling, refer patients to Patient Financial Counseling.

  • Process current copayments, coinsurance, and/or deductibles for scheduled visits and outstanding patient balances for prior patient accounts during the pre-registration process.

  • Maintains confidentiality of patients’ financial and medical records; adheres to the State and Federal laws regulating collection in healthcare; adheres to enterprise and other regulatory confidentiality policies; and advises management of any potential compliance issues immediately.

  • Participates in educational offerings sponsored by BMC or other development opportunities as assigned/available, and complies with all applicable organizational workflows and established policies and procedures.

  • Demonstrates knowledge & skills necessary to provide a level of customer experience as aligned with BMC management expectations.

  • Demonstrates the ability to recognize situations that require escalation to the Supervisor.

  • Establishes relationships and effectively collaborates with revenue cycle staff to support continuous improvement aligned with BMC management expectations as outlined.

  • Takes the opportunity to know and learn other roles and processes, and works together to assist with process improvement initiatives as directed.

  • Consistently meets productivity and quality expectations to align performance with assigned roles and responsibilities.

  • Handles telephone calls in a timely fashion, following applicable scripting and customer service standards. Appropriately manage all calls by either working with the customer or referring the call to the appropriate party.

  • Regularly undergo Managed Care Quality Audits to achieve the required standard.

  • Contact the Help Desk in the BMC Information Technology Department to report faulty systems or hardware.

  • Organize and maintain work area for efficiency, neatness, and safety.

  • Communicate with all internal and external customers effectively and courteously.

  • Maintain patient confidentiality, including but not limited to compliance with HIPAA.

  • Follow established hospital infection control and safety procedures.

  • Attend all necessary hospital and department training as required.

  • Perform other related duties as assigned or required.

  • Must adhere to all of BMC’s RESPECT behavioral standards.

(The above statements in this job description are intended to depict the general nature and level of work assigned to the employee(s) in this job. The above is not intended to represent an exhaustive list of accountable duties and responsibilities required.)

JOB REQUIREMENTS

EDUCATION:

  • High School or equivalent required. Additional professional certifications or completion of Revenue Partners training programs are preferred. SDK class training is strongly preferred as well.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS REQUIRED:

  • None

EXPERIENCE:

  • At least one year of registration experience. Advanced knowledge of insurance payers and requirements.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

  • Strong customer service skills with sound judgment, independent thinking, creativity, and problem-solving ability

  • Solid understanding of healthcare insurance (HMO, PPO, authorizations), with knowledge of healthcare terminology and CPT/ICD-10 codes

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills; able to work effectively in complex environments with diverse perspectives

  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, professionalism, empathy, and the ability to build effective relationships with patients, physicians, staff, and leadership

  • Comfortable working independently, handling ambiguity, taking initiative, and balancing multiple competing priorities

  • Close attention to detail with strong decision-making and judgment capabilities

  • Experience with Epic preferred, including proficiency in Epic workqueues

  • Strong understanding of Revenue Cycle processes and ability to meet productivity and performance standards

  • Advanced computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams) and data entry/interpretation

  • Team-oriented, able to work cross-functionally, provide backup coverage, and assist throughout the department as needed

  • Proven ability to handle challenging situations while maintaining strict confidentiality of personal and health information

Compensation Range:

$24.05- $29.31

This range offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications. However, our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and a broad range of factors is considered when making an offer. This includes education, experience, and licensure/certifications directly related to position requirements. In addition, BMCHS offers generous total compensation that includes, but is not limited to, benefits (medical, dental, vision, pharmacy), contract increases, Flexible Spending Accounts, 403(b) savings matches, earned time cash out, paid time off, career advancement opportunities, and resources to support employee and family wellbeing.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disabled/Veterans

According to the FTC, there has been a rise in employment offer scams. Our current job openings are listed on our website and applications are received only through our website. We do not ask or require downloads of any applications, or “apps” job offers are not extended over text messages or social media platforms. We do not ask individuals to purchase equipment for or prior to employment.

raw.description:
Pioneer your career! Körber is the home for passionate people who innovate, collaborate, and love what they do. Entrepreneurial spirit is our joint DNA. We develop future technologies and support talents to deploy their skills and reach their full potential. Together, we aim to be the first to do the right thing at the right time. Join the home for entrepreneurs!

The Controls Engineer II is responsible for developing control system designs, deploying and commissioning PLC code, and creating graphical user interfaces for material handling systems. This role will test code functionality prior to deployment, troubleshoot on-site, and collaborate with Electrical Engineering to design and implement control network architecture. The Controls Engineer II will also define electrical device requirements, support cost and effort estimates, review customer standards, and develop recommendations to improve productivity and reduce costs.

Your role in our team

  • You will design and deploy control systems, including programming and commissioning PLC code, developing graphical user interfaces, and validating or emulating code functionality before deployment and on-site testing
  • You will troubleshoot PLC code and electrical system functionality during on-site commissioning, supporting equipment and system testing to ensure timely project completion
  • You will collaborate with Electrical Engineering resources to define electrical device requirements, support control network architecture design, and review complex customer standards, specifications, and documentation to determine system requirements
  • You will contribute to cost and resource estimates for complex module development and commissioning activities, while monitoring system design cost alignment with equipment and engineering service project budgets
  • You will execute software quality processes through module, subsystem, and system-level test procedures
  • You will develop recommendations that enhance productivity, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction

Your profile

  • You have obtained a bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, or a related field with five (5) years of work experience in the material handling or a related industry, or 3 years of relevant work experience with a Master's degree
  • You have experience with Rockwell Automation PLC programming (including GuardLogix) and Siemens TIA Portal programming (including Starter)
  • You have experience with Ethernet/IP network architecture
  • You have experience interpreting electrical schematics and a solid understanding of HMI programming
  • You have proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with project management, engineering teams, installation crews, and external partners
  • You have demonstrated strong written and verbal communication skills with both internal teams and external stakeholders
  • You understand and support project financial tracking and schedule management while maintaining high service standards
  • You can travel up to 40% annually, including short-term assignments with 10/4 rotations as project needs require

Eligible applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. The employer will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

No Grupo Boticário, os produtos desenvolvidos e todas as histórias contadas tocam o coração e a pele das pessoas. É assim que a nossas marcas transformam momentos simples em momentos mágicos há mais de 40 anos.

Somos um Grupo que vem para questionar e ampliar conceitos sobre como fazer beleza, inspirar todos a serem livres e experimentarem possibilidades que combinam consigo mesmo. Acreditamos que as pessoas devem buscar caminhos e conquistar seus objetivos, fazendo a vida acontecer por meio do seu protagonismo.

Atuação como Key User: Atuar como usuário-chave (Key User) referência do módulo FI no SAP S/4HANA, servindo como a principal ponte relacional ("cotovelo" de tradução técnica) entre as necessidades contábeis das áreas de negócio (Fiscal, Financeira e Controladoria) e o time de Tecnologia (Tech).

Liderança de Projetos Estruturantes: Participar de forma autônoma e ativa de projetos corporativos complexos e iniciativas estratégicas da diretoria (como implementações, migrações para o SAP S/4HANA, incorporações societárias, rollouts, processos de expansão/aquisições e o projeto estruturante "Simplifica").

Ciclo de Implementação Sistêmica: Liderar o levantamento de requisitos contábeis de negócio, desenhar e validar soluções funcionais, construir e executar cenários de testes integrados (SIT/UAT) e realizar a validação funcional, garantindo aderência total às metas e prazos estabelecidos.

Adequação a Normas e Regulações Contábeis: Garantir a correta interpretação técnica, a tradução em requisitos sistêmicos no SAP e a operacionalização prática de novas normas contábeis (ex: IFRS e pautas específicas internas como o IFRS 1) e mudanças regulatórias, incluindo as complexas adaptações e impactos trazidos pela Reforma Tributária.

Qualidade e Governança da Informação: Executar e revisar rotinas contábeis críticas de fechamento, conciliações patrimoniais e análises profundas de contas, assegurando a acurácia, integridade, conformidade e redução de riscos das informações financeiras do Grupo Boticário.

Analytics e Melhoria Contínua: Acompanhar, monitorar e analisar indicadores contábeis e KPIs de performance da área, identificando tendências, antecipando gargalos e mapeando riscos operacionais para propor e implementar melhorias contínuas e automações de processos contábeis e sistêmicos.

Sustentação Contábil e Parametrização: Garantir a correta parametrização contábil, sustentação e evolução dos fluxos dentro do sistema ERP, validando a integração e a contabilização de fluxos de recebimento, faturamento, devoluções, serviços e outras operações financeiras.

Controles Internos e Gestão de Riscos: Atuar no desenho e na implementação de controles internos rígidos, sendo o responsável pelo controle de acessos sistêmicos no SAP (matrizes de risco de transações / GRC) e pela auditoria detalhada de conformidade em lançamentos contábeis manuais.

Agente de Mudanças: Atuar em uma estrutura já altamente madura e consolidada de projetos, atuando na disseminação de boas práticas, capacitação técnica de usuários e evolução contínua de processos e sistemas.

Formação: Graduação completa em Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou Economia.

Conselho de Classe:Possuir registro profissional ativo no CRC (Conselho Regional de Contabilidade) — Requisito Mandatório.

Experiência com ERP (SAP): Sólida vivência na área contábil com atuação comprovada como Key User (KUser) do módulo SAP FI. Ter participado ativamente de parametrizações contábeis e possuir visão sistêmica do ERP (experiência prática com a versão SAP S/4HANA é um forte diferencial).

Bagagem Contábil de Rotina: Conhecimento consolidado em rotinas contábeis tradicionais, fechamento mensal, conciliação e análise de contas, garantindo a habilidade técnica necessária para avaliar e prever os impactos de novos sistemas nas rotinas diárias da ponta.

Vivência em Projetos: Experiência com mapeamento de processos contábeis, levantamento de requisitos técnicos/funcionais de negócio, desenho de soluções e estruturação/execução de cenários de testes integrados (SIT/UAT) e validação funcional.

Produtividade: Domínio intermediário no ecossistema Google Workspace (foco em ferramentas de planilhas eletrônicas e apresentações estruturadas).

Diferenciais Desejáveis: Conhecimento prático básico em SQL para análise e extração de dados contábeis; familiaridade com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ou outras soluções corporativas de dados em nuvem.

Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. At Precision for Medicine we have brought together new technologies, expertise and operational scale to help the life sciences improve the speed, cost and success rate of bringing life-changing therapies to patients. What sets us apart is the way we integrate clinical trial execution with deep scientific knowledge, laboratory expertise and advanced data sciences. We have a strong focus on Oncology and Rare Disease.

Position Summary:

The Senior/Project Manager plans, directs, coordinates, and delivers activities for designated clinical study projects to ensure that project objectives of quality, scope, cost, and time are accomplished.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Serve as primary point-of-contact and primary escalation point to the client
  • Coordinate and oversees all functional services including external vendors to the established timeline and budget
  • Manage the study budget, ensuring project remains within scope and that any out of scope activities are identified early and handled as appropriate. Independently drive the CO to completion and execution with support as needed.
  • Maintain integrated collaboration with clinical operations in the delivery and participates in clinical activities as appropriate. For projects of very limited scope (i.e. number of sites), Sr. PM may assume all clinical activities
  • Manage the financial health of assigned studies, including oversight of the project profitability, billable project hours, and compliance with on time, accurate billing and forecasting to support business objectives.
  • Develop robust and comprehensive project plans, including timelines and proactive risk management and mitigation, to guide all parameters of trial execution with consistency and quality
  • Ensure Quality management for assigned projects, including eTMF Inspection readiness, implementation of quality notification incident forms and / or corrective and preventative action plans to address any quality findings.
  • Maintain integrated collaboration with all functional operations in the delivery of the program and review as necessary of other study documentation
  • Establish tracking metrics to monitor trial and team progress towards project goals
  • Prepare project status updates and report on progress to clients and senior management, including reporting on key performance indicators, offering solutions and opportunities as they arise
  • Leads both internal and client meetings and set expectations for the project team
  • Communicate effectively with client and Precision management to relay protocol/study issues including any deviations and implements necessary actions in response to those issues
  • Ability to conduct formal presentations to a wide variety of audiences including colleagues, investigative staff, and clients including Bid Defences with proficiency
  • Ensure study specific training is implemented in collaboration with functional areas and ensure study specific training compliance for the duration of the project
  • Support business development and marketing activities as appropriate, including travel to Bid Defense meetings as required
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management
  • Remain compliant with organisational training, time-reporting and any other administrative duties as required

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education/experience in science or health-related
  • Advanced degree preferred
  • Minimum of 7 years of clinical research experience or proven competencies for this position and a minimum of 4 years of direct project management experience
  • Experience in managing complex and global trials
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally including overnight stays

Other Required:

  • Experience with Microsoft Office Products (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) Microsoft Project,
  • eTMF, EDC and CTMS
  • Proven communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interface with others in a team setting

Competencies:

  • Demonstrates knowledge of ICH-GCP, relevant Precision SOPs, as well as the ability to
  • implement such items
  • Proven knowledge of project management techniques and tools

  • Good understanding of cross-functional management
  • Good understanding of project planning, risk management and change management with an
  • awareness of appropriate escalation
  • Proven experience in strategic planning, risk management and change management
  • High level of integrity and must inspire and demand the highest standards from a professional
  • and ethical perspective
  • Ability to lead and inspire excellence within a study team
  • Ability to create an environment where study team members have a sense of ownership that will
  • lead to increases in productivity and efficiency
  • Results oriented, accountable, motivated and flexible
  • Proven time management, negotiation, critical thinking, decision making, analytical and
  • interpersonal skills

Locations Required: Belgium, Canada, France, Mexico, or United States
Time Zone Preference: 6am - 12pm EST
Contract Duration: 12 months
About Us
Original Composites and Fiberglass is a global leader in glass reinforcement solutions for the composites industry. Recently separated from Owens Corning, the business now operates independently under the Praana ownership model, continuing a strong legacy of innovation, manufacturing excellence, and customer partnership.

With more than 4,000 employees worldwide, we are committed to redefining what's possible through a performance-driven culture centered on safety, quality, sustainability, inclusiveness, and employee development. Guided by our values of passion, ownership, and team spirit, we work together to deliver innovative solutions and exceptional service across the globe.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced IT Application Migration and Transition Leader to drive the migration and transition of hundreds of applications from an outsourced IT environment operating under a Transition Services Agreement (TSA) into a new IT environment that supports the company operating independently and exit the TSA.

This role will lead and coordinate the initial scoping, sourcing, implementation, deployment, transition, and operational support of a broad portfolio of applications spanning multiple business domains, including finance, sourcing, supply chain, research and development, manufacturing, legal, human resources, sales, and marketing. The application landscape includes cloud-based, hybrid, on-premises, vendor-managed, plant-level, productivity, engineering, reporting, and business applications that must be assessed, sequenced, migrated, stabilized, supported, or retired as part of the separation program.

The ideal candidate is an experienced IT professional with strong enterprise application knowledge, project leadership discipline, vendor coordination skills, and the ability to drive complex application migration activities across business, IT, infrastructure, cybersecurity, integration, service management, and third-party provider teams. This role requires the ability to translate business needs into executable application plans while ensuring business continuity, operational readiness, and alignment with TSA exit milestones.

Original Composites & Fiberglass is a business unit of the Praana Group. Original Composites & Fiberglass was recently acquired by the Praana Group. The path ahead will be dynamic, full of change, and expected to be fast paced. The business operates from more than twenty locations across the globe. The information technology environment supporting the new company is being built from the ground up across infrastructure, applications, security, integrations, and support capabilities, creating an opportunity to leverage new technologies and improved ways of working as Original Composites & Fiberglass works to exit the TSA as soon as practical.

All IT team members may be assigned IT Engineering responsibilities focused on designing, building, implementing, and maintaining technology systems that support business operations. These assignments ensure secure connectivity, scalable platforms, reliable data flow, effective application support, and business continuity during the separation from Owens Corning and the establishment of Original Composites & Fiberglass’s independent IT environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage application transition activities across multiple business domains, including finance, sourcing, supply chain, research and development, manufacturing, legal, human resources, sales, and marketing.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, application owners, IT leaders, vendors, and service providers to define application requirements, transition approach, migration scope, implementation needs, and support models.
  • Lead planning workshops, design discussions, sourcing reviews, readiness reviews, risk reviews, status meetings, and decision forums to keep application migration activities aligned and progressing.
  • Work with sourcing and procurement teams to support vendor selection, contract transition, software licensing, statement of work development, support agreements, and third-party implementation planning.
  • Partner with infrastructure, cybersecurity, identity, integration, data, network, endpoint, and service management teams to ensure migration plans address hosting, connectivity, access, security, monitoring, backup, recovery, compliance, and operational support requirements.
  • Support TSA exit planning by maintaining clear visibility to application transition status, critical path activities, blockers, resource constraints, support readiness, and leadership decisions required to complete separation milestones.
  • Drive implementation readiness by ensuring application environments, integrations, data flows, user access, testing, training, documentation, and support processes are prepared before deployment.
  • Coordinate deployment and cutover activities, including business readiness, technical readiness, communications, go-live support, issue resolution, and transition to steady-state operations.
  • Ensure appropriate operational support models are established for transitioned applications, including ownership, incident management, service request handling, vendor support, monitoring, escalation, and continuous improvement.
  • Prepare executive-ready reporting, dashboards, status updates, decision summaries, and exception reports that clearly communicate progress, risks, readiness, dependencies, and required actions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 6 to 10 years of experience in IT application delivery, application migration, application implementation, application support, technology transformation, application portfolio management, or enterprise IT leadership roles.
  • Experience leading or managing application migration, divestiture, carve-out, M&A separation, TSA exit, outsourcing transition, or global technology transformation initiatives strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise application landscapes, including SaaS platforms, hybrid applications, on-premises systems, vendor-managed solutions, manufacturing systems, plant-level applications, reporting tools, and business productivity platforms.
  • Experience supporting applications across multiple business domains, including finance, sourcing, supply chain, research and development, manufacturing, legal, human resources, sales, and marketing.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead scoping, sourcing, implementation, deployment, migration, stabilization, and operational support activities across multiple applications and workstreams.
  • Working knowledge of infrastructure, network, identity and access management, cybersecurity, integration, data migration, service management, application support, compliance, and business continuity concepts.
  • Strong vendor management skills, including experience coordinating third-party providers, implementation partners, managed services teams, software vendors, and outsourced IT service providers.
  • Ability to build integrated plans, manage dependencies, sequence migration waves, coordinate cross-functional resources, and drive readiness across business and IT teams.
Work Conditions
  • Potential 20% travel required.
  • Due to the team structure, virtual meeting formats, global time zone differences, and appropriate meeting times, extended work hours may be required.

  • Drafting pleadings, motions, and other litigation documents

  • Conducting legal research and preparing case assessments
  • Assisting with expert discovery and construction-related litigation issues
  • Preparing for hearings, mediations, arbitrations, and trial

You will have the opportunity to take on meaningful responsibility from day one while working alongside attorneys handling significant construction defect matters throughout the West Coast.

  • Active license to practice law and in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction

  • Prior construction defect defense experience
  • Experience with civil litigation, including pleadings, discovery, motion practice, and litigation strategy
  • Strong legal research, writing, analytical, and communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple cases, deadlines, and competing priorities
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently while functioning effectively as part of a collaborative litigation team
  • Ability and willingness to work with a team operating primarily on Pacific Time
  • Proactive, ownership-driven approach and a strong interest in developing as a trial lawyer

Compensation & Career Growth

The anticipated base salary range is $120,000–$185,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Segal McCambridge offers attorneys the opportunity to develop sophisticated litigation skills while working on significant matters with experienced trial lawyers. Associates are encouraged to take meaningful responsibility for their cases, develop client relationships, and build a long-term career within the firm.

Why Join Segal McCambridge?

Segal McCambridge combines the resources of a national litigation firm with the collegiality and accessibility of a close-knit team. Our attorneys handle complex, high-value litigation for leading companies and organizations, with a strong emphasis on trial readiness, subject-matter expertise, and client service.

  • Fully remote work environment

  • Professional development support

About Segal McCambridge

Founded in 1986, Segal McCambridge has grown from a boutique firm in Chicago into a national litigation powerhouse. The firm represents Fortune 500 companies and other leading organizations in complex litigation, including construction, insurance defense, product liability, transportation, environmental, and general liability matters.

Our attorneys are recognized for their trial readiness, deep litigation expertise, and commitment to delivering exceptional results for clients.

raw.description:
Reports to: Vice President Solutions & Services

Location: Remote USA

About Proscia

Proscia is revolutionizing pathology, the last major frontier in healthcare to embrace digital. As a leader in pathology AI software, we are empowering pathologists and scientists to transition from traditional microscope-based workflows to digital, AI-driven approaches, unlocking new possibilities in precision medicine.

The digital pathology market is experiencing explosive growth as advances in AI enable unprecedented insights into diseases like cancer. Pathology is central to medicine, and the shift to AI-powered solutions is not just modernizing workflows—it’s transforming how diseases are diagnosed, treated, and understood. Predictions for the future of pathology show a tidal wave of adoption, with experts describing the field as “poised for the next major breakthrough” in healthcare innovation.

Backed by over $100 million in funding from leading healthcare and technology investors, Proscia is at the forefront of this revolution. Joining Proscia means being part of a company at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, where the possibilities are limitless. With the convergence of AI, precision medicine, and digital pathology, we’re not just changing pathology—we’re redefining what’s possible in medicine.

About Solutions & Services

Solutions & Services sits at the intersection of our customers, our technology, and how Proscia delivers value. We connect the customer journey from early discovery and solution design through implementation and go-live, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Technical Support, and Operations.

Our goal is to make implementations more predictable and easier to scale: understand customer needs early, use proven approaches where possible, execute with strong technical discipline, surface risks quickly, and turn what we learn from each deployment into a better experience for the next customer.

Role Overview

The Senior Implementation Engineer is a hands-on technical delivery role responsible for implementing Proscia’s digital pathology solutions for customers. This person owns the technical implementation from readiness through go-live stabilization and works closely with Solution Architects, Project Managers, customers, Product, Engineering, and Technical Support.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical implementation of customer deployments, from readiness and installation through configuration, integration, testing, acceptance, and go-live stabilization.
  • Work with Solution Architects to turn approved solution designs into technical configurations that meet customer requirements and Proscia standards.
  • Work with Project Managers to plan technical work, manage customer prerequisites and dependencies, and keep technical milestones on track.
  • Configure and deploy customer environments across application, infrastructure, networking, storage, identity, and integration components.
  • Implement and troubleshoot integrations across customer infrastructure, networks, storage platforms, identity systems, and upstream/downstream systems.
  • Execute and validate data migrations, imports, and transfers when needed, and verify data completeness and integrity before cutover.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across application, infrastructure, networking, storage, and integration layers.
  • Identify technical risks and blockers early, explain their impact, and work with the right teams to resolve them.
  • Own technical readiness for customer testing, validation, acceptance, go-live, and transition to Technical Support.
  • Develop scripts, automation, and reusable deployment tools using Git, peer review, testing, and established SDLC and change-management practices.
  • Capture recurring deployment issues, product gaps, and lessons learned, and share them with Product, Engineering, and the implementation team.
  • Mentor Implementation Engineers and help raise the technical bar across the team.
  • Improve deployment standards, documentation, and working practices so the team can deliver consistently across customers.

Experience & Technical Requirements

Technical Expertise

  • Strong hands-on experience with Linux and Windows operating systems, including command-line operations and system troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency with scripting and automation using Bash, PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Strong understanding of web-based application architectures, networking, DNS, SSL/TLS, certificates, firewalls/proxies, identity/SSO, RBAC, and enterprise security fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience deploying and supporting applications in AWS and/or Azure, including compute, storage, identity, databases, and networking.
  • Experience with enterprise storage technologies such as AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage, NFS, or similar.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases, with the ability to query, validate, and troubleshoot data during implementations, integrations, and migrations.
  • Experience deploying, configuring, and troubleshooting containerized applications using Docker and/or Kubernetes in enterprise or production environments.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise integrations, including REST APIs and file-based interfaces. Experience with healthcare or laboratory environments such as LIS, HL7/FHIR, clinical imaging, scanners, DICOM, or digital pathology workflows is preferred.
  • Experience integrating enterprise applications with identity providers, storage systems, network infrastructure, and upstream/downstream clinical or business systems.
  • Ability to troubleshoot distributed systems across application, infrastructure, networking, storage, and integration layers.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code or configuration management tools such as Terraform or Ansible is preferred.

Professional Experience & Skills

  • 7+ years of experience in enterprise IT, technical implementation, solutions engineering, professional services, or related roles.
  • Proven ability to lead complex technical implementations, make sound technical decisions, manage risk, and escalate issues when needed.
  • Strong customer-facing communication skills and the ability to explain technical solutions to engineers, IT teams, architects, and senior customer stakeholders.
  • Ability to connect technical decisions to customer workflows, implementation outcomes, and long-term supportability.
  • Experience handling technical responsibilities across multiple customer projects while maintaining quality and follow-through.
  • Takes ownership, raises risks early, improves how the team works, and follows issues through to resolution.

Beyond Just Work

As a company in healthcare, we want our people to be happy and healthy, in and out of the office. In addition to competitive pay, we ensure everyone on our team is supported with savings, schedule, and insurance options that promote long-term health and personal growth.

Our office environment is designed for creativity and agility: with walls as notepads and couches for collaboration. We’re located in the heart of Philadelphia, with views of the city so you can spend your time focusing on what matters most.

At Proscia, we don’t just accept differences — we celebrate them, we support them, and we thrive on them for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community. Proscia is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Position Overview
The Managing Director is responsible for leading large-scale healthcare transformation programs that combine consulting, advanced analytics, AI-enabled technology, workflow redesign, governance, and change management to improve clinical, operational, financial, and patient outcomes across health systems.

This executive leader serves as the senior client advisor, Engagement Executive, portfolio leader, business executive, and innovation champion for a portfolio of Command Center engagements. The role is accountable for portfolio performance, strategic account growth, client satisfaction, talent development, product innovation, and the establishment of scalable delivery standards across the Command Center ecosystem. The Managing Director is recognized as an internal and external thought leader who helps shape the future direction of healthcare operations.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Client Leadership

raw.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

OverviewofRole:

The Senior Director, Regulatory Affairs, CMC, provides global regulatory leadership and strategic oversight for Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) activities across the portfolio. This role is accountable for defining and executing global CMC regulatory strategy for biologics (large molecules) throughout all phases of development and commercialization.

The Senior Director partners closely with CMC, Supply Chain, Quality, Technical Operations, and Regulatory colleagues to ensure compliant, high‑quality, and timely global submissions. This role leads regulatory CMC strategy for development programs and marketing applications, oversees preparation and maintenance of CMC regulatory filings, and serves as a senior regulatory authority in interactions with global Health Authorities.

Roleand Responsibilities:

  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight for global CMC regulatory activities across assigned programs and the broader portfolio.
  • Define and execute global CMC regulatory strategy to support clinical development, licensure, and lifecycle management of biologic products.
  • Represent Regulatory CMC at the senior project team and governance levels, providing strategic guidance to enable successful product development and approval.
  • Lead cross‑functional collaboration with CMC, Supply Chain, Quality, and Regulatory Affairs to develop and align global regulatory strategies and submission plans.
  • Oversee the planning, development, and finalization of high‑quality CMC regulatory documents to meet global regulatory requirements.
  • Provide executive oversight of internal CMC submission review and approval processes to ensure compliance, quality, and alignment with company strategy.

  • Ensure proactive assessment of regulatory impact related to CMC changes, deviations, and lifecycle management activities; direct preparation of associated regulatory submissions.

  • Escalate significant regulatory risks or compliance issues to senior leadership and provide clear recommendations for resolution.

  • Mentor, develop, and provide leadership to Regulatory CMC staff, fostering a high‑performing and collaborative team environment.

Experience,EducationandSpecializedKnowledgeandSkills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Pharmacy, Engineering, Biochemistry, or related scientific discipline required; advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) strongly preferred.
  • 10 or more years of Regulatory CMC experience and/or related pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry experience required, with demonstrated leadership responsibility.
  • Significant experience with biologic products across clinical development and commercialization required.
  • Deep and comprehensive knowledge of FDA, EU, and other global CMC regulatory requirements and expectations.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex regulatory concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, influence, and collaborate across functions at both operational and senior leadership levels.
  • Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple, time‑sensitive priorities.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, demanding, and highly collaborative environment while maintaining attention to detail, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance.

raw.description:
Who We Are:

Chestnut Carbon is a leading developer of nature-based carbon removal solutions, focused on generating high-quality, U.S.-based forest carbon projects that are additional, verifiable, and designed to accelerate the path to net zero. Founded in 2022 with the support of energy-focused alternative asset manager Kimmeridge, Chestnut uses a proprietary, technology-enabled approach to restore and conserve forestland—maximizing ecological value and long-term climate impact.

To date, Chestnut has planted over 17 million trees across 30,000 acres and enrolled more than 175,000 acres of privately owned forestland in its improved forest management program. Our projects deliver measurable environmental benefits, including enhanced air and water quality, biodiversity, and wildlife habitat.

Chestnut was named one of TIME Magazine’s Top GreenTech Companies of 2025 and received both the FSC President’s Award and the distinction of being the first U.S. project verified through FSC’s Verified Impact program for Biodiversity Conservation.

Chestnut was founded and backed by Kimmeridge, a US-based private equity firm with offices in New York and Denver.

Position Summary:

Forest Carbon Works, a subsidiary of Chestnut Carbon, offers private US forest landowners conservation programs that help them access carbon credit markets while preserving their land and legacy. As the Membership Coordinator of a nature-based solutions company committed to developing high-quality voluntary carbon offset projects, this person will support landowner members from enrollment through ongoing program participation, providing day-to-day administrative, communications, agreement, CRM, reporting, and payment support. The position reports to the Membership Manager and works closely with Membership Advisors, Finance, Legal, Forestry, GIS, and other internal teams to ensure the highest standards are met.

The ideal candidate will have strong organizational and customer service skills, a high level of attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain accurate records in a remote environment.

Responsibilities

    • Guide members from signed agreement through ongoing participation, coordinating onboarding with Finance, Legal, and Natural Resources.
    • Manage member lifecycle events: annual surveys, ownership changes, land transfers, easement reviews, amendments, and terminations.
    • Maintain accurate member records and documentation in Salesforce and SharePoint.
    • Serve as the day-to-day contact for routine member questions, escalating complex matters to the Membership Manager.
    • Send scheduled communications, reminders, program updates, and surveys, and track participation and follow-up.
    • Prepare amendment packages from approved templates and route them for review and signature.
    • Review documentation for completeness and record amended terms in the CRM and designated repositories.
    • Support deed, entity document, easement, and payee-change reviews, escalating compliance questions as needed.
    • Run standard CRM and payment reports, audit data, and correct discrepancies.
    • Prepare payment calculations and requests, track approvals and status, and record issuance in the CRM.
    • Partner with Finance on payment processing, reconciliation, and routine member payment questions.
    • Coordinate with Forestry, GIS, Product, Lease/Due Diligence, MRV, and Legal on member requests and audits, and document standard operating procedures.

About You

    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
    • Previous experience of 3+ years in account management, customer support, or membership administration.
    • Experience with a CRM platform such as Salesforce or HubSpot; Ironclad, email marketing automation, or payment operations a plus.
    • Experience administering agreements, including reviewing contracts, drafting amendments, and maintaining compliance records (preferred).
    • Strong communication skills, including both oral and written.
    • Strong organizational and planning skills, as well as a high-level attention to detail.
    • Strong time-management and self-management skills and can take direction and work independently to reach identified goals on a set timeline.
    • Can maintain a high level of professionalism and discretion in dealing with highly sensitive project deliverables.
    • Experience with MS Office; and familiarity with spreadsheets and SharePoint.
    • Have a commitment to solving the environmental challenges of our time.
    • Willingness to travel domestically (limited).
    • Able to work effectively with remote team members throughout the U.S.

Physical Requirements

    • Sitting: Must be able to sit for extended periods of time.
    • Standing and Walking: Occasionally required to stand and walk.
    • Manual Dexterity: Frequent use of hands to handle, control, or feel objects, tools, or controls.
    • Repetitive Movements: Ability to perform repetitive movements, such as typing and using a mouse.
    • Visual Acuity: Close visual acuity required for viewing a computer screen and reading documents.
    • Communication: Ability to understand and communicate clearly with others.
    • Lifting: Occasionally required to lift and carry objects weighing up to 20 pounds.
    • Bending and Stooping: Occasionally required to bend, stoop, and reach.
